params.body:
#161 landed with three PHPStan errors in the scan (the array shapes of the two token copies were too loose for the analyser); #162 carried the fix but conflicts now that #161 is on main. This is the same fix on top of main: explicit shapes for both copies, no behaviour change. PHPStan green, suite 547 green. #160 and #162 can be closed.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: De sleutelmeting PHPStan-schoon na #161 (#160 en #162 sluiten)
